The rule that says what a plain Diamond cash table is lived in FIVE SQL functions and had drifted into five different rules, with both kinds of error live at once: fn_poker_diamond_top_up refused straddles, run it twice and bomb pots that three migrations earlier the same day had permitted, and it read an UNSET rake as zero while never reading rake_cap_bb at all. Migration 20260912061500, applied once to kuklfnapbkmacvwxktbh, makes it one function that every Diamond money door and staff door reads. The two money doors are edited in place from their live definitions rather than restated; the three staff doors are restated so each tests the row it is ABOUT TO WRITE, which is the question a door that turns a feature on actually has to answer. The hand settler deliberately keeps its own narrow check and is asserted to stay exempt: by settlement the hand is dealt, and refusing a dealt hand on a feature flag parks the table. The predicate below is the only new object.
